EMULATOR cl_kappa HEAD: STAT_SPECS['cl_kappa'] = StatSpec('Cl_kappa.npz','cl','log',None,'cl_err',('ell',)) at src/bind/emulator/dataset.py:79 — confirmed by reading. I fitted it with the notebook's exact recipe (Emulator(backend='gpgpu', n_components=12, backend_kwargs={'epochs':400,'lr':0.1}), seed-0 203/50 split): k=12 PCs retained; predict returns cl_kappa (50,5,5,724), cl_kappa_err (50,5,5,724), plus derived cl_kappa_auto (50,5,724) and suppression (50,5,724); using the notebook's own metric definitions median |frac err| = 2.58%, response R^2 = 1.00, cov |z|<1/<2 = 0.69/0.91, z_s=1 auto slice 2.61%; peak RSS 0.895 GB. Every one of those numbers matches the spec.

PREDICT BRANCHING at src/bind/emulator/core.py:180-197 is exactly as described: 'if "suppression" in names' wins and sets cl_kappa_auto = suppression*cl_dmo, leaving out['suppression'] as the direct head; the 'elif "cl_kappa" in names' fallback only fires when suppression is absent. out['cl_kappa'] is always the directly-emulated 5x5 cube. Adding cl_kappa to STATS_EMU therefore does not move fig09a/fig15/fig10 numbers. Confirmed empirically: my single-head probe took the elif branch and produced a derived 'suppression'.

corrections.claim: Adding the cl_kappa head costs '+15.5-22.9 s measured on 1 CPU' and 'raises the fig09 fit from 128 s to ~145 s'.
corrections.correct_fact: I measured 38.0 s for the cl_kappa head alone with the notebook's exact recipe on this 1-CPU / no-GPU session (printed '[fit] cl_kappa: 203 runs, k=12 PCs, gpgpu backend'; predict 0.11 s; peak RSS 0.895 GB). That is 1.7-2.5x the claimed range, and it is consistent with §4.0's documented CPU reference of 584 s for 14 heads (= 41.7 s/head). The baseline is also wrong (see the previous correction). Correct statement: executed GPU fit 27 s -> roughly 29 s with a 15th head; documented CPU reference 584 s -> roughly 625 s.

Two of the twelve do not. The manifest/STAT_SPECS say suppression transform = 'raw' and pdf transform = 'log1p'; the proposed FAM13 dict (correctly, matching the existing FAM8 at old-3108 and old-3113) uses 'log' for S(l) and 'raw' for PDF. The dict values are the right choice — they preserve the published fig08 behaviour — but the stated rationale is false, and an implementer who takes it literally and 'fixes' the two entries to match STAT_SPECS will silently change the published EVR and rho numbers.

corrections.claim: backends.py: 'MLPEnsemble.fit, opt.step() re-indented from outside the minibatch loop to inside it (line ~105)' — and the §4.0 prose ('opt.step() outside the epoch loop') is therefore 'consistent'.
corrections.correct_fact: There is no minibatch loop. At src/bind/emulator/backends.py:99 the code does xb, zb = Xt[idx], Zt[idx] — full-batch — and line 101 is 'for ep in range(c["epochs"]):', the EPOCH loop. The fix moves opt.step() (line 105) inside the epoch loop, i.e. the original code took exactly one optimizer step per model. The §4.0 prose 'opt.step() outside the epoch loop' is literally correct; it is the spec's description (and FIGURE_EDIT_PLAN.md item 10's 'inside the batch loop') that is wrong. The conclusion (real bug, zero effect on gpgpu figures, keep the fix, commit it) stands.

corrections.claim: CR10-5: plot every spectrum panel over mE = ELL <= 2e4, and 'if the ell cut is ever widened past 2e4 ... those panels must switch to symlog' (framed as a hypothetical risk).
corrections.correct_fact: This contradicts a binding campaign decision the spec never consulted. FIGURE_EDIT_PLAN.md 'Verified hard constraints' item 1 states: 'The released spectra grid already spans 86.9 -> 52 133.6. **Action: extend the l axis from 2x10^4 to the full 5.2x10^4** and say so.' I audited the FULL 724-bin grid at z_s=1: cl_kappa (1.469e-13..9.540e-09), cl_yy, cl_tt and cl_yt stay strictly positive; suppression widens from 0.764-1.503 to 0.686-2.645; but cl_kappa_y and cl_kappa_tau DO go negative — first negative at ell = 51727 and ell = 52032 respectively, affecting 0.7% and 0.3% of bins and 0.1% of values. So the symlog requirement is not hypothetical: those two panels need symlog (or a clip just below ell = 5e4) if the plan's extension is honoured, and the S(l) panel's y-range must be re-set.

corrections.claim: CR10-5 panel spec: peak_counts xlim(-3,6), minima_counts xlim(-5,4), no limits on V0/V1/V2; PDF x = d['a__pdf__pdf_bins'].
corrections.correct_fact: FIGURE_EDIT_PLAN.md 'Verified hard constraints' item 2 mandates a uniform nu = -3...8 axis on all six nu panels with the V_i curves terminating at 4 (the MF grid is hard-capped at -3.0...4.0, 29 bins — I confirmed a__mf_v0__mf_nu spans exactly -3..4). The plan's canonical table also specifies 'PDF ... kappa -> nu via sigma0[zi]', whereas the spec plots the raw kappa bins (-0.2214..0.2214). Data gap the spec did not identify: there is NO sigma0 key in emulator_dataset_xpkfix.npz (non-t__/a__ keys are exactly X_native, X_unit, run_ids, source_redshifts, param_names, cl_dmo, manifest, xpk_cross_fix) and no sigma0/sig0/kappa_rms anywhere in the builder. The closest cached source is t__moments__value (253,5,3,4) with a__moments__smoothing_scales_arcmin (3 scales); otherwise the conversion must be dropped and the kappa axis kept.

corrections.claim: 'permutation null over 66 pairs x200 shuffles: 1.3 s' and 'The whole 12-family PCA+CCA+null costs ~1.5 s'.
corrections.correct_fact: I measured 5.0 s for the 66-pair x 200-shuffle null alone on this session (the 21-pair version scales to ~1.6 s, not the claimed ~0.4 s). corrections.claim: 'Bonus: the inset is the sole cause of the "Axes not compatible with tight_layout" UserWarning emitted at line 3470 in the executed notebook.'
corrections.correct_fact: No executed notebook exists in the tree (zero outputs, see above), so the warning was not observed.
